simulations.title: Six events, four slots
simulations.description: Both inputs consume the same worker budget; extra partitions cannot create processor slots.

action.text: Properties shows two Consumes rows, but one 4/s pool. At 6/s total, waiting work grows by about 2/s.

simulations.title: Measured faster work
simulations.description: A 500 ms measured service time doubles the same four-slot pool to 8/s, above the combined 6/s demand.
